svg.title: Apartments on office land
svg.desc: Two perspectives with ten picks each. Overall ranks compare the estimated impact of all twenty points. Equal scores share a rank.
svg.text: Should your city allow apartments on land set aside for offices?

g.title: Idle office land — Bring underused parcels back into use.
g.text: Bring underused parcels back into use.

g.title: Schools and utilities — Check water service and school capacity.
g.text: Check water service and school capacity.

g.title: Room for housing — Open more sites for new homes.
g.text: Open more sites for new homes.

g.title: Walkable streets — Wide roads may lack safe crossings.
g.text: Wide roads may lack safe crossings.

g.title: Shorter commutes — Some sites sit near workplaces.
Land for employers — Retain sites for future jobs.
Shop customers — Bring shoppers outside office hours.
Neighbors and noise — Check nearby freight and industrial uses.
g.text: Check nearby freight and industrial uses.

g.title: Transit connections — Build within reach of buses or rail.
g.text: Build within reach of buses or rail.

g.title: Conversion costs — Windows and plumbing constrain reuse.
Housing choice — Add apartments among detached homes.
Traffic planning — Plan for different routes and peak hours.
g.text: Plan for different routes and peak hours.

g.title: Outward growth — Ease pressure to build farther out.
g.text: Ease pressure to build farther out.

g.title: Affordable homes — Seek affordability terms before rezoning.
Clear zoning rules — Builders can plan around known rules.
g.text: Builders can plan around known rules.

g.title: Flood exposure — Check low ground and stormwater needs.
g.text: Check low ground and stormwater needs.

g.title: Evening activity — Keep streets active after offices close.
g.text: Keep streets active after offices close.

g.title: Everyday services — Can people reach groceries and clinics?
g.text: Can people reach groceries and clinics?

g.title: Existing utilities — Reuse roads and nearby utility lines.
g.text: Reuse roads and nearby utility lines.

g.title: Neighborhood input — Flag local issues before approval.

svg.text: AI impact weighs magnitude (50%), reach (30%) and duration (20%).
